name: claudesay
description: An ASCII mascot in a pane beside the chat: it holds a prop while a tool runs and says the point of each reply

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: on: after each conversational reply, a small model (Haiku) writes one line, and the mascot says it in its pane; it also holds a prop while a tool runs. tools: props only, no model calls. off: no mascot.

sleepAfter.title: Sleep after
sleepAfter.description: How long the session sits idle before the character falls asleep.

restAfter.title: Rest after
restAfter.description: How long the session sits idle before the mod rests: the snore stops and no new bird comes, until something wakes the character. Never sooner than Sleep after.
